Iva Primorac Pavičić (born 10 April 1996) is a Croatian tennis player. Primorac Pavičić has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 377, achieved on 14 July 2025. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 502, reached on 23 November 2015. Primorac has won two single and five doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . Primorac Pavičić made her debut for Croatia in the Billie Jean King Cup in April 2024 playing doubles in the Europe/Africa Zone .
